fusions.name: Sore-Headed Slam
fusions.desc: Rears up and comes down, dealing 14 damage to every enemy within 2.5 tiles and knocking them 3 tiles back. Its damage rises 6% for every 10% of your health already gone (max 30%).

fusions.name: Goring Maul
fusions.desc: Gores and mauls the target for 28 damage plus 5% of a boss's or elite's maximum health, leaving it [Bleeding] for 3 damage a second for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Dug-In Bulk
fusions.desc: Plants your hooves, reducing the damage you take by 25% for 12 seconds.

fusions.name: Winter Fat
fusions.desc: Your maximum health rises by 12, and you regenerate 0.5 health a second.
